app.name: Trado
app.description: A personal journal for cryptocurrency spot trades.

auth.phoneHint: International format, or an Iranian number starting with 09.
auth.otpLater: One-time codes are not enabled yet. Sign in with your password.

dashboard.title: Portfolio
dashboard.subtitle: Figures come only from the trades you record. Nothing is priced from the market.
dashboard.realizedHint: Average cost inside each trade. Buys and sells are never matched across trades.
dashboard.netCashHint: Sold minus bought, using the rate stored on each entry.
dashboard.oversoldNote: {count} trades sold more than they bought. Open the trade to review the grouping.
dashboard.performancePending: Performance against initial capital is not calculated yet. Live market prices are not tracked.
dashboard.emptyBody: Record a buy or a sell. Later entries stay in the trade you choose.

trades.title: Trades
trades.subtitle: A trade is a group of buys and sells you put together yourself.
trades.emptyBody: Nothing is matched automatically. You decide which entries belong together.
trades.createSubtitle: Start a trade with its first buy or sell.
trades.rateHint: Toman per 1 USD at the time of this entry.
trades.noAssetsBody: An asset is the coin or token this trade is about.
trades.deleteTradeConfirm: Delete this trade and every entry in it? This cannot be undone.
trades.titleHint: Optional. The asset name is used when this is empty.
trades.methodNote: P/L uses average cost within this trade only.

assets.title: Assets
assets.subtitle: Coins and tokens you record trades for.
assets.name: Name
assets.emptyBody: Add a symbol such as BTC before recording a trade.
assets.inUse: This asset is used by a trade and cannot be deleted.
assets.symbolHint: Letters and numbers, up to 12 characters.

settings.title: Settings
settings.phoneLocked: Changing your number will require a one-time code. That is not enabled yet.
settings.name: Name
settings.currencyHint: Both currencies stay visible. This chooses which one leads.
settings.capitalHint: The USD you started with, and the Toman rate on that day.

validation.positive: Enter a number greater than zero.
validation.date_future: Date cannot be in the future.
validation.date_past: Date is too far in the past.

errors.validation_error: Check the form and try again.
errors.invalid_credentials: Phone number or password is incorrect.
errors.phone_taken: An account with this number already exists.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.asset_in_use: This asset is used by a trade.
errors.asset_exists: You already have an asset with this symbol.
